queries.item: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:zoho_referrals` ( `referral_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL, `ip` varchar(20) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`referral_id`), KEY `user_id` (`user_id`,`ip`) ) Engine=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET UTF8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:zoho_authentications` ( `zoho_authentication_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `access_token` varchar(100) NOT NULL, `refresh_token` varchar(100) NOT NULL, `created_at` int(11) NOT NULL, `type` varchar(20) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`zoho_authentication_id`), KEY `type` (`type`) ) Engine=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET UTF8;
